scope_note: Batch 1 covers GitLab-era authored blog posts (Dec 2021 → present) on about.gitlab.com. All 9 candidates are net-new to content-db/posts.json (which currently has ZERO GitLab-byline rows). Every entry has a live evidence_url confirmed HTTP 200 on 2026-08-14. Author attribution 'Fatima Sarah Khalid' confirmed via GitLab blog author metadata (canonical author key: fatima-sarah-khalid, per about.gitlab.com repo content/en-us/blog/author/fatima-sarah-khalid.yml). NOTE: GitLab migrated blog URLs from dated paths (/blog/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/) to slug-only (/blog/slug/); the slug-only form is now canonical and the dated form 404s — evidence_urls below use the live slug-only form.
coordination_note: Does NOT re-import the 4 existing content-db posts. Two of those (building-contributors-garden [featured:true], civic-signal-map) are flagged for downgrade/quarantine pending Fatima's decision on the dead GitLab projects they rest on (see _scout-posts-love-2026-08-14.md and PROJECTS batch). This batch is entirely independent of that decision.

curator_summary: 9 net-new GitLab bylines, all verified-live-byline with HTTP 200 evidence_urls (fetched 2026-08-14). Spans Apr 2022 → Aug 2025, covering the full GitLab Developer Evangelist / Sr Developer Advocate arc. Mix of technical tutorials (static site generators, ChatGPT-on-issues, C++ testing, C++ adventure game, Duo Agentic Chat), LinkedIn Live recaps (security deep dive, ICYMI), community/customer essays (Co-Create), and a culture piece (shadow programs). One co-byline (Duo Agentic Chat, w/ Daniel Helfand). Content-db currently has zero GitLab-byline posts, so this is pure additive coverage with no merge conflicts.
